H3 Android foreground recovery, verified reference reuse, durable owner-scoped submission receipts and duplicate-safe Create Video retries; accurate connection/login/upload errors with existing models, routing and permissions preserved.

TEST-only H3 Smart References & First Frame: shared optional timeline anchor and mixed image/RefMod selection, installed-node capability gating and shared reference-count validation. Owner generation acceptance pending; not approved for GitHub or PROD.
